description: Plum-purple floor-length fitted gown with low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves, gold geometric woven trim at neckline, cuffs, waist and front skirt edges. Paired round shoulder brooches, decorated belt with round central fitting and hanging end, cream shawl with red/gold patterned borders over forearms, small pendant, earrings and rings, gold-brown embroidered shoes. Both hands visible. No headgear, armor or weapon.
